__comment: Generic S3-compatible storage (AWS S3, IDrive e2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, MinIO, ...). No OAuth: the customUI app com.palm.app.s3-auth collects endpoint/region/bucket/access-key/secret and calls com.palm.service.s3/login, which validates them (SigV4-signed ListObjectsV2) and returns the stored credentials. Provides BOTH DOCUMENTS and PHOTO.UPLOAD.
__comment2: com.palm.app.s3-auth MUST be in write/readPermissions: createAccount runs under the customUI auth app's identity and is permission-checked against these lists.
__comment3: com.palm.service.s3 is in read+writePermissions so the service can readCredentials(accountId) for file ops. S3 keys are static (no refresh), so the service does not normally write back, but the permission is kept for symmetry.

capabilityProviders.__comment: The file-picker app and the account-derived QuickOffice reroute consume listFolder/downloadFile/uploadFile. Locators are S3 keys/prefixes; the root sentinel maps to the empty prefix (bucket root).

Makes the S3 bucket a photo source. The Photos aggregator calls com.palm.service.s3/listAlbums+listPhotos; one prefix ('Camera Uploads/') is surfaced as one album. src_big is a short-lived PRESIGNED GET URL (SigV4 query signature), which the aggregator's curl fetches with no auth header.
